matrix_dimensions: four independent 64x64 Hermitian weighted-Gram C4 sectors at each precision
budget_scope: 3600s active controller wall per initial invocation, prior recorded worker time deducted on manual resume; polling/kill/serialization overshoot reported. No automatic retry. Sampled working-set limit, not a Windows job-object allocation limit.
expected_runtime: NOT_BENCHMARKED_AT_TARGET_PRECISIONS; resource cap is not a completion promise
selection_basis: Retained-spectrum extrapolation ~1e-274..1e-284, plus certified global lambda_min>=1e-312. The 400/500-digit builds are independent; no high-precision eigensolve has been launched.
numerical_success_criteria: all256 strictly positive modes retained at BOTH independently built precisions
all256 sector-matched eigenvalues agree to relative1e-20; use cluster projector comparisons if necessary
C agreement <=2e-11; w agreement <=2e-12 AND relative0.001 (local Phase E diagnostic targets)
direct variance agrees with norm residual at the declared precision; all finite physical inputs
certification_boundary: The controller only saves numerical diagnostics. A separate assessment must justify input rounding, inverse-square-root amplification, eigenvector/cluster errors and the resulting C,w uncertainty. Displayed-digit agreement or sector completion cannot automatically certify C,w or upgrade source evidence.
additional_review_required: rigorous matrix/functional enclosure if a rigorous C,w error claim is made
cross-precision spectral/eigenvector and observable assessment; no automatic certification
independent assessment that observed uncertainties satisfy the declared local tolerance scope
